note: Phase 4 = the rest of the fleet, primaries only (fallbacks stay in proposals/fleet.json and are promoted here only if a primary fails inspection). Order of use follows spec D7: Concorde → 747-400 → F-22 → A321, then the rest. FlightGear rows are GPL (D16): the converted glTF and the converter are published under the GPL in this public repo; each aircraft's authors are credited from its own README/AUTHORS. The hangar's H145 stays procedural.
